text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but I should not let that feeling alone decide when to sell; I need to consider each stock's prospects and my overall plan.","Holding through losses avoids the discomfort of realizing them, but doing nothing is still a decision. I should review whether a losing position still deserves its place in my portfolio.","I traded very little while my account value fell from 104,474 to 100,257, so I should check my portfolio periodically and assess its overall direction rather than assume that inactivity is always best."]}
